metric_names: global/layer gradient norm ratios and angles
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Separate exec experiments.cvs_urban_branch50.evaluate.score; all seven predictions complete before truth
metrics_plan.selection_rule: No single-seed best-position claim. Pilot family expands all eight with seed02/03 if any auxiliary has source L_dev final50 low +1pp, clean>=-0.5pp, urban>=0pp, worst urban RX>=-1pp vs A0. Target is reporting only.
metrics_plan.later_combinations: After three-seed source evidence, select b1/b2 from T/F/P/R/S: each improves source low in all3 seeds, mean>=0.5pp, mean clean>=-0.5pp, urban>=0pp, worst>=-1pp. Sort low gain, then urban, then worstRX; differences<=0.2pp prefer fewer constraints/lower measured extra cost. Add b1+b2, b1+J, b1+b2+J only with at least2 qualified singles; recalibrate combined total once from same warmup snapshot. No target selection.
